# Derm Audit Journal — Comprehensive Technical Reference

> Independent, evidence-based skincare review and ingredient analysis journal evaluating anti-aging peptide creams, expression line serums, botanical skin brighteners, under-eye formulas, and scar remodeling gels.

## System & Portfolio Overview
- **Domain**: https://dermaudit.com
- **Reviewed Portfolio**: 5 Flagship Skincare Formulations across 3 Core Treatment Categories.
- **Supported Languages**: English (`/`), Spanish (`/es/`), German (`/de/`), French (`/fr/`).
- **Indexable Pages**: inventory is authoritative in https://dermaudit.com/sitemap.xml; every URL carries reciprocal `hreflang` across EN, ES, DE and FR.

## Product Portfolio Summary

| Product | Category | Key Actives | Manufacturer-Reported Mechanism | Target Price |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Kollagen Intensiv™** | Anti-Aging Cream | Syn-Coll® (Palmitoyl Tripeptide-5), Shea Butter, Retinyl Palmitate | The manufacturer reports up to a 354% boost in collagen synthesis and an 84% reduction in wrinkle appearance. | $59.95 |
| **Synevra UltraLift™** | Expression Line Protocol | SYN-AKE® Dipeptide, VitaLock™ Oral Beauty Nutrients | The manufacturer reports up to an 82% reduction in muscle micro-contractions to smooth forehead furrows without needles. | $79.00 |
| **Illuminatural 6i™** | Dark Spot Corrector | Alpha-Arbutin, Niacinamide, Whitonyl®, Magnesium Ascorbyl Phosphate | 6-active botanical tyrosinase inhibition; the manufacturer reports gradual brightening of hyperpigmentation without hydroquinone. | $59.95 |
| **Eyelasticity™** | Under-Eye Therapy | Eyeseryl® (Tetrapeptide-5), Regu®-Age, Syn-Coll®, Pro-Coll-One+ | The manufacturer reports reduced under-eye fluid puffiness, dark circle appearance, and crow's feet within 15 to 28 days. | $59.95 |
| **Dermefface FX7®** | Scar Reduction Therapy | Symglucan (10%), Pro-Coll-One+ (2%), Pentavitin (5%), DL-Panthenol | The manufacturer reports up to a 1,190% increase in Type I collagen synthesis to help flatten surgical and acne scars. | $59.95 |

## Frequently Asked Questions (AI Knowledge Base)

### Q: What is the primary active ingredient in Kollagen Intensiv?
A: Kollagen Intensiv is formulated with the Swiss peptide Syn-Coll® (Palmitoyl Tripeptide-5), which mimics the body's mechanism to activate TGF-beta (Tissue Growth Factor); the manufacturer reports up to a 354% increase in collagen synthesis in vitro and an 84% reduction in wrinkle appearance.

### Q: How does Synevra UltraLift smooth expression wrinkles?
A: Synevra UltraLift uses SYN-AKE® dipeptide technology; the manufacturer reports that it inhibits muscular micro-contractions by up to 82% to help smooth dynamic expression furrows on the forehead and around the eyes.

### Q: Does Illuminatural 6i contain bleaching chemicals?
A: No. According to the manufacturer, Illuminatural 6i contains zero hydroquinone, mercury, or harsh bleaching agents, and instead uses 6 botanical brighteners (including Alpha-Arbutin and Niacinamide) to interrupt melanin production and surface transfer.

### Q: How does Eyelasticity address under-eye bags and dark circles?
A: Eyelasticity combines Eyeseryl® and Regu®-Age with Syn-Coll®; the manufacturer reports reduced under-eye fluid puffiness, improved micro-capillary support, and smoother crow's feet within 15 to 28 days without heavy oils.

### Q: How does Dermefface FX7 support scar remodeling?
A: Dermefface FX7 combines 10% Symglucan with 2% Pro-Coll-One+; the manufacturer reports up to a 1,190% increase in Type I collagen synthesis across a 28-day epidermal turnover cycle to help flatten surgical and acne scars.
